# goinfer model × hardware matrix

Every family runs on the pure-Go CPU path; the GPU columns show resident
acceleration with automatic, correctness-guaranteed CPU fallback (a backend that
does not implement a family's features DECLINES to the staged/CPU path rather than
running it silently wrong). Generated from `decoder.ResidentEligible` — arch flags
plus the shared feature taxonomy, the single source of truth the runtime admits on.
Regenerate with `go test ./decoder -run HardwareMatrix -update`.

Resident acceleration above is CAPABILITY (does the backend implement the family's
features). Two load-time notes the taxonomy does not encode:

- **Memory fit:** Metal Mistral-7B needs > 16 GB unified memory (int8 + int4); MoE
  residency is unified-memory-bound.
- **Precision policy:** Nemotron-H resident is int4-only by default (int8 is opt-in via
  `GOINFER_SSM_RESIDENT`) — a precision choice applied at load, not a capability.
